title: Easel: the flat trail (TRAIL.flat 0.75, land::flat_cost in the map, parse and plain, the stage test, the fallout on the retro maps and the red cases' texts, scouting.md's line, flat.md)
why: Open 0, New 0, Miss 1, Reach 2 = 3: haiku medium. Open 0: the value is settled by the spec probe (probe.md: 0.75 holds both bounds and moves trade and Standing), and the rule is one helper (land::flat_cost, in land.rs since map.rs is over 1200 lines) called in three places. New 0: hidden trail costs are the pattern. Miss 1: a stage test it writes, and the fallout the suite shows. Reach 2: every walk and line on flat land. I expect Haiku medium to land it, with most of its time on the fallout: pins, map-pinned asserts and the two red cases' texts, which the brief says how to move without changing a rule. About 10 files, 250 lines plus flat.md. Part and score agree.

title: Easel: the search and the orders (scout.rs split into units/search.rs, best-case order, search_view's reasons, the scout's Move and dest, line_from and past_reach, the notes, Sim fields, search.md)
why: Open 0, New 1, Miss 1, Reach 2 = 4: haiku high. Open 0: the order key is the owner's test's best_case exactly, and search_view, Move, line_from and the notes are named to the field in spec items 7-13. New 1: Move is the camp's adapted, and the order comes from the test. Miss 1: cases.rs flips green, and it writes the stage tests. Reach 2: the scout's turn runs every turn for every civ, and the walk home goes. I expect Haiku high to land it, with a retry on making the engine's walk price match the test's to EPS. About 10 files, 750 lines (the move is about 400 of them). Part and score agree. Spec-review: the brief now names line_by (not line_with), prices cost through from two cost maps so view() stays cheap, and says what to do if the owner's case still fails on a mountain outside the candidate ranges (the test's open set is every mountain); still Open 0, since cases.rs says done.

title: Easel: the scout's feeding (units/forage.rs split out of units/mod.rs, spare and graze_at, rich ground by what a turn's foraging brings, the wander filling the pack, the idle scout, the hunger reason, SCOUT's starting numbers, scout_errand on the stage with 28 errands and a refilled control, feeding.md)
why: Open 2, New 1, Miss 1, Reach 2 = 6: sonnet medium. Open 2: the rule is settled in spec items 14-22, but its numbers are starting values, and the errand test may have to land ignored. New 1: forage_round and strip_at are the pattern, and the wander is a small state machine on the scout. Miss 1: the stage tests it writes; the real-map proof is the canvas's. Reach 2: every scout's turn, the AI's idle scouts included. I expect Sonnet medium to land it, keeping the wander's states (errand, wandering, idle) straight across turns and saves. About 9 files, 650 lines (the forage.rs move is about 70 of them). An easel at 6, as the shape expects for its hardest easel. Part and score agree. Spec-review ran a rough version of this rule on the retro maps (review-probe.md): rich ground as the round's raw spare loses 2 to 5 of 14 routed errands, the labour-aware measure none on main's maps, and a wandering scout must forage for its pack's room or it never counts as fed. The brief now says both and gives starting numbers that ran (wander 4, low 2, fed 4, rich 1.5). On the flat-trail maps they still lose 3 routed errands, so expect the errand test to land ignored.

title: Canvas: the scout lives through every errand (SCOUT's numbers against the 28 errands and the AI's scouts) and the flat trail re-measured against main (errand.md, trail.md)
why: Open 4, New 1, Miss 3, Reach 2 = 10: opus low on the ladder, run a rung below as Sonnet high, as each piece runs its canvas. Open 4: a search over wander range, rich, the hunger and fed thresholds, whether the errand fills the pack, reach, people and a scout's pack, judged by 28 errands living and the work the routed ones get done against a refilled control. New 1: the errand test, its control and the sweep exist. Miss 3: only the retro maps show a scout living. Reach 2: every scout's turn. Spec-review's probe (review-probe.md) is the starting point: on the flat-trail maps labour-aware rich ground at rich 1.5, low 2, fed 4 loses 3 routed errands and 1 idle one, and the living scouts do a fifth of a fed scout's work. I expect Sonnet high to close the last losses (a bigger scout pack or a wider wander for the far errands to a rival capital) and to report the work honestly, with an ask if it stays under a quarter; and to keep the flat trail at 0.75 (probe.md). About 4 files, 200 lines plus two records. Part and score agree.

title: Review the piece
why: The goal is judged by play and by runs against main: the three buttons' visible results, 28 errands alive, and the flat trail's trade and Standing past the floor with the AI's orders not halved. Four easels, three of them Haiku, feed one canvas that may change them, and the flat trail moves every digest and the maps under the red cases: the review reads what each step left half-done and checks the canvas's answer. It writes the answer and the evidence into the PR and adds the decisions to scouting.md's, supply.md's, page.md's and map.md's ledgers.
